Here is the complete ordered list of everything that happens on `POST /api/owners`. This maps to `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` (the v2 controller only exposes a paged list). There are three distinct stages: security, Bean Validation on the request body, then the mapping + `ClinicServiceImpl.saveOwner` side-effects.

## Stage 1 — Authorization (before the method runs)
1. `@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")` — caller must hold the `OWNER_ADMIN` role, else 403.

## Stage 2 — Bean Validation (`@Valid @RequestBody`, before the method body)
These fire via `@Validated`/`@Valid` on the generated `OwnersApi.addOwner`. Field- vs class-level ordering is not guaranteed by the Bean Validation spec, but the constraints applied are:

**Field constraints (`OwnerFieldsDto`):**
2. `firstName` — `@NotNull` + `@NotBlank`, `@Pattern ^[\p{L}]+([ '-][\p{L}]+){0,2}$` (letters, up to two space/apostrophe/hyphen-separated parts), `@Size 1–30`.
3. `lastName` — `@NotNull` + `@NotBlank`, `@Pattern` (same, but allows one optional trailing `.`), `@Size 1–30`.
4. `city` — `@NotNull` + `@NotBlank`, `@Size 1–80`.
5. `telephone` — `@NotNull` + `@NotBlank`, `@Size 1–20`, and `@TelephoneValidation`: must normalize to valid E.164 (`+` followed by 8–15 digits) via `TelephoneNormalizer`.
6. `email` (optional) — `@Email` (syntactic), `@Size max 255`, and `@EmailDomainValidation`: domain must not be on the disposable blocklist (`mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`).
7. `address` (optional flat form) — `@Size max 255`, and `@AddressValidation`: if supplied, must be non-blank after normalization.
8. `addressLine1` / `addressLine2` (optional) — each `@Size max 255`.
9. `postcode` (optional) — `@Pattern ^[0-9]{4}$` (exactly 4 digits).
10. `registrationDate` (optional) — `@PastOrPresent` (cannot be in the future).
11. `birthDate` (optional) — date-format only; **note there is no past/present constraint on it**.

**Class-level constraints (whole DTO):**
12. `@PostcodeValidation` — when a postcode is present, it must fall in the city's known region range (`PostcodeRules`: Sydney→NSW 2000–2099, Melbourne→VIC 3000–3099, Brisbane→QLD 4000–4099; unknown city accepts any 4-digit code).
13. `@AddressFormValidation` — the payload must carry an address in **at least one** form: a non-blank-after-normalization `addressLine1` **or** a non-blank-after-normalization flat `address`.

> Note: `title` is documented as an enum (MR/MRS/MS/DR) but has **no** validation annotation — any string passes.

## Stage 3 — Controller body (`addOwner`)
14. Read the `Idempotency-Key` header. If present and non-blank, look up an existing owner by that key (`findOwnerByIdempotencyKey`); **if one is found, short-circuit and return it with `200 OK`** — no new owner, no further side-effects.
15. Map the DTO to an `Owner` (`OwnerMapper.toOwner`), which itself transforms:
    - `address` is **composed**: preferred structured `addressLine1` (+ `addressLine2` appended with a space) if present, else the flat `address` — each normalized by `AddressNormalizer` (trim, collapse internal whitespace, upper-case, expand street types ST→STREET, RD→ROAD, AVE→AVENUE).
    - `addressLine1`/`addressLine2` normalized the same way.
    - `telephone` normalized to canonical E.164.
    - `email` normalized (trimmed + lower-cased).
    - `id`, `pets`, `idempotencyKey` ignored by the mapper.
16. If an idempotency key was present, set it on the owner.
17. Call `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)`.

## Stage 4 — `saveOwner` side-effects (executed in this exact code order)
18. Capture `isNew`.
19. Resolve effective `registrationDate` = supplied value, or **default to today** if absent; then **roll it forward to the next business day**, skipping weekends and the fixed 2026 public holidays. The adjusted value is stored and used by every date-derived step below.
20. *(new only)* Compute and set `householdId` = first 12 hex chars of SHA-256 over `normalizedLastName|postcode` (null if either is missing).
21. *(new only)* Find existing non-deleted household members (same last name + postcode); set `householdMemberCount` = members + 1.
22. *(new only)* If the household already has members: throw **`HouseholdDuplicateException`** (409) **unless** `sharesHousehold` is true — in which case the owner is marked a declared household member (and exempted from the soft-duplicate flag below).
23. *(new only)* If the owner's full `identityKey` (`normalizedTelephone|email-or-empty|householdId`) already belongs to any non-deleted owner: throw **`DuplicateIdentityException`**.
24. *(new, non-declared-member only)* Soft-match check: if another non-deleted owner shares last name + postcode but has a **different** telephone, set `possibleDuplicate = true` and `possibleDuplicateOf` = that owner's id (lowest id wins). Owner is still created.
25. *(new only)* If the count of existing owners in the same city (case-insensitive) ≥ `MAX_OWNERS_PER_CITY`: throw **`CityOwnerLimitExceededException`**.
26. *(new only)* If the count of existing owners already registered on the adjusted date ≥ `MAX_OWNERS_PER_DAY`: throw **`DailyOwnerLimitExceededException`**.
27. *(new only)* If `customerCode` is null, generate it: `<REGION>-<HASH8>` (region from postcode/city; 8 upper-hex of SHA-256 over normalized telephone + last name), with a `-<n>` suffix appended to break collisions.
28. *(new only)* Set `namesakeCount` = number of existing owners with the same first+last name (case-insensitive); set `bulkSignupWarning` = (owners registered that day > 80).
29. If `membershipNumber` is null, generate `<customerCode>-M<YY>` (YY = last two digits of the registration date's fiscal year, FY starting 1 July).
30. `ownerRepository.save(owner)` — persists the row.
31. *(new only)* Emit an `AUDIT` log line (id, customerCode, membershipLevel, membershipNumber, registrationDate).

## Stage 5 — Response
32. Build a `Location` header `/api/owners/{id}` and return the `OwnerDto` with `201 CREATED`. During response mapping, `OwnerMapper`/`Owner` also derive read-only fields (`displayName`, `initials`, `salutation`, `locality`, `timezone`, `contactPreference`, `ageBand`, `telephoneDisplay`, `fiscalYear`, `selfLink`, plus membership points/level, check digit) — these are computed on read, not persisted.

A couple of things worth flagging while reading: `birthDate` is **not** constrained to the past (unlike `registrationDate`), and `title` has no enum enforcement despite its documentation.
